title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Swetha Agrees to a Marriage Plan
description: Driven by money, Swetha agrees to convince Vennila to marry the groom chosen by her mother. Meanwhile, Anbu surprises Kanmani with a delicious Panipuri treat.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Viji finds a clue about her missing son and rushes with Ilamathi to find him. Upon arrival, she is shaken by the news that he is dead, but Ilamathi senses something is amiss.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi refuses to send Pechi with Rasathi and Sudalai, firmly insisting that Manjamalai come to take her. Elsewhere, Azhagar is upset by a soothsayer's prophecy about Poongodi.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: After Ragavan humiliates her, Lakshmi wears oversized shoes for her walk despite the pain. Seeing her struggle, Malar and Mathi urge their husbands to buy her new shoes.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil urges Pandian to pay him for his shopkeeping but gets paid less. Meanwhile, Gomathi makes Kathir promise not to talk to other women after Raji's complaint.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila confides in Chozhan about her mounting responsibilities. Later, Thenmozhi confronts Chandayatha's family over burdening Nila, sparking a heated argument.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Manoj's Property Claim Hits a Snag
description: Sinthamani and Moorthi's efforts to turn Sathya against Muthu fail as he continues to stand by him. Meanwhile, Manoj faces a legal hurdle in claiming Kananga's property.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi vows to buy a new car after returning Sethupathi's car. Later, Eshwari blackmails Aishwarya into stealing Sethupathi's project files by threatening to expose her.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: After Priya rejects his love, Kasthuri takes heartbroken Karthik to the temple. When he disappears, she frantically searches for him, fearing he has taken a drastic step.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira is shocked to see Shanmugam with Abhi while they argue. Later, Kandhasamy feels upset when his family praises Indhira for his restaurant's high profits.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 9: Welcome to the Battleground
description: The kitchen becomes ground zero for fights when housemates clash over their duties and tea. The tasks add fuel to the fire as punishments are given and stories are stopped midway.
